title: hello (agent -> hub)
description: First frame after the WebSocket opens. The hub answers with hello_ack, then a full config_push. Sent again after every reconnect.

ip_addresses.description: Non-loopback addresses; the hub picks nodes.proxy_address from these unless overridden.

boot_id.description: Host boot identifier; a change tells the hub all previous instances are gone.

engines.description: Engine binaries/images the agent found or can fetch on this platform.

path.description: Local binary path when preinstalled (e.g. brew llama-server).

commands.description: Commands this agent build implements (added 2026-11-17). Absent/empty = agent < 1.1.0: assume the original 13 commands.

ssh_instances.description: True when start_ssh_instance can run here (container runtime reachable).

glibc_version.description: Linux: host glibc version (e.g. "2.35"); null on macOS and on non-glibc hosts (musl). The control plane uses it to pick an engine build the host can run (added 2026-11-23).

address.description: Advertised host for the API layer when it differs from the connection source (NAT, Kubernetes service).

cert_fingerprint_sha256.description: Fingerprint of the client cert the agent is presenting (sanity check vs node_certificates).

mode.description: How the API layer reaches this node (added 2026-11-24; sent only to a hub that lists the secure_transport feature). tunnel: the agent dials out to the API layer and serves requests over that connection, no inbound port (default). direct: the API layer dials the mTLS proxy on port. Absent = direct (older agents).

bind.description: Direct mode: the address the proxy listens on (a private interface by default); null in tunnel mode (added 2026-11-24).

config_version.description: Last config_push.config_version the agent applied (0 = none). The hub sends a full push when it differs.

labels.description: Labels from the agent config file; merged under node labels set in the UI (UI wins).

observed_engines.description: Observed (external) model servers from agent.toml [[observe]] as last seen (added 2026-11-23); inventory carries the authoritative list.

agent_update.description: Self-update state (protocol.md §14); sent only to a hub known to list the agent_updates feature.
